name: Now showing
description: A video-recorder front panel reads ▶ 1:58 in teal fluorescent segments behind smoked glass, with an orange film-reel annunciator and a progress bar most of the way through.
choices: Seven-segment digits keep their ghosted unlit segments; annunciators become play, pause, record and a film reel
A runtime and a part-filled progress bar make the panel about watching films, not hi-fi; no lettering is used
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
